what_is_included: Empirical size uncertainty is estimable within replicated samples. A singleton has no empirical within-sample variance.
remaining_limit: Same-program/taxon sparse-size variance sensitivity; intervals remain conditional on that assumption.

what_is_included: Original measurements give a mean diameter for a size class, not every individual diameter.
remaining_limit: Within-group variation and the bias from applying a nonlinear equation to a mean cannot be recovered from these files.

what_is_included: Shared physical-unit resampling represents observed sampling variation. All-zero or unreplicated units cannot reveal their full sampling variance.
remaining_limit: Residual process uncertainty remains; this is not a complete detection/count-observation likelihood.

what_is_included: Direct measurements stay with their count unit; separate size surveys have no individual links to counted animals.
remaining_limit: Their unobserved count–size covariance cannot be estimated; do not describe the intervals as total uncertainty.

what_is_included: Reviewed PISCO target and calibration scope is enforced; size-sampling scatter is removed from residual prediction scatter before adding donor draws.
remaining_limit: Prediction variance is conditional on estimated calibration and a lognormal working approximation; sparse calibration remains weak evidence.

what_is_included: Same physical site and declared date rule; no borrowing across years or unrelated sites.
remaining_limit: Unsupported biomass remains missing, with density retained. No new KFM lobster biomass is inferred.

what_is_included: Joint process terms and shared measurement draws connect documented physical stations.
remaining_limit: Verified shared satellite pixels inform an overlap-weighted process kernel. Their spatial covariance and cross-program overlap remain unestimated; geometry alone is not a complete sampling covariance.

what_is_included: Joint models estimate AR1 dependence using actual calendar gaps; fixed-dependence sensitivities remain available.
remaining_limit: Variance and AR-boundary fits require attention. Confidence limits condition on nuisance covariance estimates.

what_is_included: Point coefficients and observed monthly kelp coefficients are used consistently.
remaining_limit: Coefficient covariance, detection bias, habitat mismatch and causal counterfactual validity are not measured by these intervals.

what_is_included: This is a coordinated review build, not a manuscript release.
remaining_limit: Pathway/resilience/figure outputs in the paper must be regenerated and checked against an approved cohort before publication; no paper files changed.
